requirements.control: Enforce opaque UUIDv4 or ULID identifiers on all public routes; forbid sequential integer IDs (Anti-IDOR).
Isolate multi-tenant data at the database engine layer via PostgreSQL ENABLE and FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY.
Hash passwords exclusively with Argon2id (min 64 MB RAM, 3 iterations, parallelism 4) or support WebAuthn/FIDO2 Passkeys.
Bind session cookies with __Host- prefix and Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict attributes.
Sign JWT access tokens exclusively with asymmetric ES256 or RS256 (15-60 min TTL); reject alg=none and symmetric HS256.
Evaluate fine-grained resource access via Google Zanzibar relation tuples (Ory Keto ReBAC) with default-deny policy.
Validate all HTTP inputs with strict schema validators (Valibot strictObject / additionalProperties: false) and MAX_BODY_BYTES <= 64 KB.
Encrypt zone_restricted PII columns using AES-256-GCM Envelope Encryption with ephemeral DEKs wrapped by HSM-backed GCP Cloud KMS CMKs (90-day rotation).
Forbid storing raw 13-19 digit payment card PANs; store only opaque PCI DSS v4.0 payment tokens in zone_confidential.
Redact PII entities (emails, PANs, phones, bearer tokens) via Presidio-pattern filters before writing logs or AI telemetry; never leak err.stack in HTTP responses.
Persist security audit trails in Write-Once-Read-Many (WORM) zone_audit_worm tables blocking UPDATE and DELETE via database triggers.
Enforce TLS 1.3 (hostssl + scram-sha-256 for Postgres) and HSTS max-age=63072000; includeSubDomains; preload.
Validate Fetch Metadata headers (Sec-Fetch-Site, Sec-Fetch-Mode, Sec-Fetch-Dest) and HMAC-SHA256 webhook signatures with a 300s anti-replay window.
Enforce Content-Security-Policy with frame-ancestors none, object-src none, base-uri self, and suppress Server/X-Powered-By headers.
